scope: Synthetic documents, real host/importer code and mocked public Figma API; no live Figma or pixel rendering test.
tests: Idle and writing sessions cannot be overwritten; terminal cancellation releases assets and allows restart
Cancel ACK waits for font-stage importer termination; late font resolution cannot mutate a new session
Cancellation during node creation rolls back only current file before terminal ACK
Rollback failure is nonterminal and blocks cancel, restart and new batches
Batch destination survives page switches; duplicate filenames get distinct names and nonoverlapping roots
Success receipt survives late cancellation without deleting committed content or reporting it cancelled
Unseen cancellation fences delayed begin; invalid batch/session requests cannot mutate an active job
Deleted destination fails before node creation; file-level failure terminal allows safe next attempt
Terminal receipt cache stays bounded and contains only compact metadata after many sequential sessions
Client identity and monotonic session ticket validation isolate stale or malformed UI instances
Lost success delivery never changes committed receipt into failure; cancellation can recover compact success
